Apparent contradiction: PRED-1261.H1 (2026-06-05) holds that the Socratic names were 'not (on available evidence) one hidden biological person'; PRED-1569.H31 (2026-08-31) states 'one hand wrote Plato and Socrates, and probably Xenophon and Aristophanes'. #1569 Round 43 (line 3341) describes itself as the thesis 'restated at full strength... rather than against a hedged version'. Apparent contradiction: PRED-1570.H4 (M16, 'Plato does not construct heteronymically', the one attested-target case reads negative) stands against the heteronymic-configuration series (PRED-167.H1, PRED-859.H7) and PRED-1569.H31. Left unlinked as a set; recorded here.

Apparent contradiction: PRED-660.G2 / PRED-661.G2 (DOI-anchored deposits cannot be removed and persist independently of platforms) against PRED-540.B1 / PRED-546.B1 (the seal depends on the DOI server persisting). Both sides are in the 'durability of the DOI anchor' series.
PRED-1268.B2's 410 is Medium's 410 Gone on the Johannes Sigil account (#1268 lines 23-60), not a DOI failure; the claim is the DOI outliving a platform erasure.
PRED-1659.H1 was linked by the triage to PRED-1569.H28 (another group); PRED-1584.H2 (same set here) belongs with that claim too.
PRED-653.D1 and PRED-658.D1 were already 'related' in the triage; this pass promotes them to one claim, since #653 names the Encyclotron as the instrument its sentence speaks of.

PRED-859.H7 (Socrates as the mask through which Plato's authorship is distributed) is close to the Kahn-type reading that PRED-1569.H45 departs from; kept in the series rather than the same set with PRED-167.H1 / PRED-1569.H45.
